profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Allen Institute
profile.summary: I have been specializing in designing and implementing software to enable scientific research for 7+ years. Specifically, I'm focused on infrastructure to proactively trace scientific data analysis to ensure reproducibility and provide a robust ingest and search functionality of large datasets and clinical metadata.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Proposed the design of our metadata management microservice based on schematic custom data design with a  Data-Driven API for dynamic table views based on organism metadata 
- Lead design sessions for scaling our Mongo Aggregation Pipeline reducing wait time by minutes
- Improved team cohesion and efficiency by implementing automated Swagger/OpenAPI generation

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
- Improved and scaled systems 
- Re-architect infrastructure to improve efficiency, speed, and address user needs.
- Mentor junior software engineers

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Lead multi-database migration to transition to a multi-tenant system 
- Auth API using JWT and Google IAP 
- Use Gorm and MySql to implement an account management system

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Develop REST APIs and deploy microservices with Docker and Kubernetes 
- Collaborate with computational biologists to implement scientific data pipelines using Google PubSub and Argo Workflows

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
•	Created and presented demonstrations of Itron IoT products by connecting various sensors to Itron microprocessor and displaying data with a HTML interface.
•	Authored documentation to clearly state setup of demonstrations.
•	Gained experience traveling for work and observing project status presentations as well as presenting my work to the Ideas Lab team
•	Designed and conducted field tests with a small team to compare radio signal strength on Itron’s new IoT products.

publications.title: Provide proactive reproducible analysis transparency with every publication
publications.publisher: Royal Society for Open Science · Mar 5, 2025
